scientific_integrity: Derives a pointwise border-polynomial sign and an exact first-hit integral from the cited established generating-function identity; general proof supplied, finite checks corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: For one nonempty binary target word in an iid fair binary source. Does not extend to multiple patterns, other alphabets, or biased distributions; the conclusion is about expected stopped sample proportion, not shift frequency. Priority beyond inspected sources and independent mathematical validation remain unconfirmed.
title: Longest imbalanced borders determine first-hit letter bias
